headline: Week 2026-W46: 4 advertisers on the public record
executive: 1 advertiser kept creative live 90+ days (Safaricom PLC 104d) — persistence, not performance proof.
strategic: Safaricom PLC (meta): 104 days live, 4 active ads observed (captured-card basis). Teardown candidate — check what the landing page is doing that the ad promises.
methodology: All numbers come from deterministic classification of captured observations (lib/signals.js): tenure from library start dates, variant counts from ad cards, active-ad counts from the card's advertiser-level figure with our captured-card count as the labelled fallback.
Scale bands read active ad counts, never variant counts — variants are creatives, not ads.
Interpretation is layered on top of those numbers; the AI layer, when enabled, receives only the computed facts and may not introduce advertisers, numbers or quotes.
limitations: Signals are not proof: long-running ads can be losers on autopilot; variant counts can be formats, languages or placements rather than new hooks.
Spend is not public outside political ads — nothing here estimates budgets.
Kenyan commercial ads are not in Meta's Ad Library API; coverage is limited to what was actually captured from the public libraries this week.
Delivery is scheduled, not guaranteed — collection depends on capture discipline and platform availability.
